- Large dark brown/black necrotic lesions at leaf margins/tips
- Yellow to tan zone surrounding the dark necrotic areas
- Irregular lesion shape, no obvious white coating

Top candidates: Early_Blight, Late_Blight, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus, Verticillium_Wilt

Now viewing one reference from each of 4 different classes:

The Verticillium Wilt reference is a strong match for the test image. Both show:
- Dark brown/black necrotic tissue at leaf margins
- Yellow to tan transitional zone surrounding the necrosis
- V-shaped pattern widest at the leaf margin

This matches the symptom description precisely: "V-shaped leaf lesions widest at the leaf margin, brown necrotic tissue surrounded by irregular yellowing."

Early Blight reference showed a concentrated dark spot on otherwise green leaf (no yellow zone). Late Blight showed extensive brown spreading with fuzzy sporulation. TSWV showed ring/mosaic patterns — all distinctly different from the test image.
